attempts.summary: Pinned curl on node1 (RHEL 7.9) against future yum updates by adding `exclude=curl` to /etc/yum.conf. Verified via falsification (curl 7.29.0-59.el7_9.2 update appears when exclude removed, disappears when restored) and by temporarily wiring a CentOS-7-vault repo to run a real `yum check-update`/`yum update` against it — curl stayed excluded while other packages showed as updatable. Removed the temporary verification repo afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id 33b0e84c... pre-restart, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until reachable again with new boot_id 8acfcef2..., and confirmed post-restart that curl is unchanged, the exclude directive persisted in /etc/yum.conf, and the system is healthy (systemctl is-system-running == running).
